# Thirza Abernethy

## Overview

- **Age:** Over sixty years old  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v4 c34 P10](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0010), [v4 c38 P0](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley, St. Brendan’s Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** Homemaker and farm manager  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c3 P51](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0051)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Aunt Thirza  <sub>[v1 c8 P8](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0008), [v1 c8 P12](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0012)</sub>

## Appearance

Thirza is a tall, slender woman with sharp angles rather than curves. She has dark hair with graying strands bound in a tight bun combatively pierced by wire hairpins, and a sallow face with a mouth showing a redeeming hint of humor. As she ages, her hair turns white.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c13 P11](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0011), [v3 c31 P6](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0006), [v4 c34 P3](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0003)_

## Personality

Thirza has a limited background and a firm, unyielding sense of morality, maintaining an agonizing cleanliness and order in her household. She is practical, abrupt, and stern in speech, often trying to suppress her deep capacity for affection under a mantle of moralizing and sarcasm. Although she considers herself incapable of imagining things differently than they are and disapproves of daydreaming, she possesses an underlying sense of humor and deep loyalty.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009), [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c4 P10](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0010), [v1 c8 P15](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0015), [v1 c8 P19](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0019), [v1 c10 P50](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0050), [v3 c30 P3](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0003)_

## Goals

- To raise Nell into a well-behaved, practical, and religious young woman  <sub>[v1 c6 P34](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0034), [v1 c7 P14](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0014), [v1 c12 P7](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0007)</sub>
- To maintain proper order and morality at Grey Shutters  <sub>[v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009), [v1 c7 P1](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0001)</sub>
- To care for the orphaned Farrow twins, Robin and Lucy  <sub>[v2 c7 P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v2 c8 P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002)</sub>

## History

Thirza Abernethy lived a quiet, structured life at Grey Shutters in Brierley with her brother Obed. Due to a communication error when trying to adopt a boy to help on the farm, they were sent a young orphan girl named Nell Harcourt. Though Thirza initially planned to send Nell back, she felt compassion for her and agreed to keep her. She took on the task of raising, educating, and disciplining Nell, teaching her religious prayers, sewing, and house chores, while trying to curb Nell's wild imagination and temper. After her brother Obed died suddenly following a bank failure, Thirza decided to remain at Grey Shutters. She later welcomed two young orphans, the Farrow twins Robin and Lucy, taking on their care and upbringing. As she aged, Thirza faced failing eyesight, leading her to invite her lifelong friend Agatha Sowerby to move into Grey Shutters to live with her. Eventually, she saw Nell graduate from college and marry Hugh Carrow, the son of her former youthful sweetheart.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c3 P4](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0004), [v1 c5 P21](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0021), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c7 P14](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0014), [v1 c9 P45](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0045), [v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v2 c7 P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v2 c8 P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002), [v4 c4 P3](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0003), [v4 c4 P15](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0015)_
